fields.name: pocket_restraints

fields.name: protein_sequence
fields.label: Protein sequence
fields.help: Join chains of a complex with a colon to fold them as one record.

fields.name: num_recycles
fields.label: Recycles
fields.help: More recycles refine the prediction at a proportional runtime cost.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.label: Attention chunk size
fields.help: 0 disables chunking; lower values trade speed for less memory.

fields.name: cpu_offload
fields.label: Offload parameters to CPU
fields.help: Keeps large sequences within GPU memory at the cost of speed.

fields.name: heavy_sequence
fields.label: Heavy-chain sequence
fields.help: Variable domain only; constant domains are not modelled.

fields.name: numbering_scheme
fields.label: Numbering scheme
fields.help: How the residues of the returned structure are numbered.

fields.name: n_threads
fields.label: CPU threads for refinement
fields.help: 0 refines on the GPU; any other value forces OpenMM onto that many CPU threads.

fields.name: no_sidechain_bond_check
fields.label: Skip the strained-bond check
fields.help: Slightly faster, at the risk of an occasional unphysical side chain.

fields.name: original_weights
fields.label: Use the original TCRBuilder2 weights
fields.help: Off by default, which uses the newer TCRBuilder2+ weights.

fields.name: peptide_sequence
fields.label: Peptide sequence
fields.help: Join the chains of a complex with a colon; the first chain is the cyclic peptide.

fields.name: cyclic_constraint
fields.label: Cyclic constraint
fields.help: Which constraints the cyclic offset matrix is built from.

fields.name: disulfide_pairs
fields.label: Disulfide pairs (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated 1-indexed cysteine pairs, for example 3-11,5-17. Inferred from the sequence when left empty.

fields.name: msa_mode
fields.label: MSA mode
fields.help: Short macrocycles have no useful alignment, so single-sequence is the usual choice.

fields.name: amber_relax
fields.label: Relax the top model with Amber
fields.help: Cleans up bond geometry at the cyclization point, at a few minutes of extra runtime.

fields.name: target_file
fields.label: Target structure (PDB or mmCIF)
fields.help: Uploaded structure file for the binding target.

fields.name: target_chains
fields.label: Target chains (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated chain IDs to include from the target file; blank includes all.

fields.name: binding_site
fields.label: Binding site (optional)
fields.help: One "chain:residues" per line, e.g. "A:5..7,13"; BoltzGen residue ranges use "..".

fields.name: not_binding_site
fields.label: Excluded site (optional)
fields.help: One "chain:residues" per line, residues the binder must not contact.

fields.name: peptide_target_file
fields.label: Target structure (PDB or mmCIF, optional)
fields.help: Leave blank to design a free peptide with no target.

fields.name: peptide_sequence
fields.label: Peptide sequence pattern
fields.help: A fixed sequence, a length range like "10..20", or a mix using BoltzGen's pattern syntax.

fields.name: peptide_disulfide_bonds
fields.label: Disulfide bonds (optional)
fields.help: JSON list, e.g. [{"position1": 2, "position2": 10}], 1-indexed into the peptide. Positions must land on a literal residue already written into the sequence pattern (e.g. a "C"), not inside a design-length run.

fields.name: cyclotide_sequence
fields.label: Cyclotide sequence pattern
fields.help: BoltzGen sequence pattern mixing fixed residues and design-length runs.

fields.name: cyclotide_disulfide_bonds
fields.label: Disulfide bonds
fields.help: JSON list of 1-indexed {"position1", "position2"} pairs. Positions must land on a literal residue already written into the sequence pattern (e.g. one of its "C"s), not inside a design-length run.

fields.name: nanobody_framework_file
fields.label: Nanobody framework structure (PDB or mmCIF)
fields.help: A solved nanobody scaffold to graft new CDR loops onto.

fields.name: nanobody_cdr_regions
fields.label: CDR regions to redesign
fields.help: Residue ranges in the framework file, BoltzGen syntax (e.g. "26..34,52..59,98..118").

fields.name: nanobody_cdr_exclude
fields.label: Framework residues to drop (optional)
fields.help: Residue ranges to strip from the template before redesign, e.g. to shorten a loop.

fields.name: nanobody_cdr_insertions
fields.label: Variable-length insertions (optional)
fields.help: JSON list, e.g. [{"position": 26, "lengths": "1..5"}], inserted at a framework residue.

fields.name: diffusion_batch_size
fields.label: Diffusion batch size (optional)
fields.help: Leave at 0 for BoltzGen's own default.

fields.name: omit_amino_acids
fields.label: Omit amino acids from inverse folding (optional)
fields.help: One-letter amino-acid codes to avoid when designing sequences.

fields.name: skip_refolding
fields.label: Skip refolding and confidence filtering
fields.help: Stops after design and inverse folding; faster, but skips BoltzGen's own quality filtering.

fields.label: Target antigen PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A TARGET ANTIGEN PDB HERE

fields.name: target_hotspots
fields.label: Epitope hotspots
fields.help: Comma-separated target residues that define the epitope, for example A56,A57,A58.

fields.name: max_trajectories
fields.label: Trajectories to run
fields.help: Hallucination trajectories attempted; most are discarded by the filters.

fields.name: max_passing_designs
fields.label: Designs to keep
fields.help: The run stops once this many designs have passed every filter.

fields.name: target_pdb
fields.label: Target antigen PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A TARGET ANTIGEN PDB HERE

fields.name: target_chains
fields.label: Target chains
fields.help: Comma-separated if the target is bound across more than one chain, for example A,B.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Epitope hotspots (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated target residues, for example A56,A57. Empty lets mBER bind anywhere on the target.

fields.name: num_accepted
fields.label: Designs to keep
fields.help: The run stops once this many trajectories have passed the iPTM/pLDDT filters.

fields.name: max_trajectories
fields.label: Trajectories to attempt
fields.help: Upper bound on attempts if num_accepted is never reached.

fields.name: complex_pdb
fields.label: Antigen-antibody complex PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE AN ANTIGEN-ANTIBODY COMPLEX PDB HERE
fields.help: The framework and antigen are read from this structure; the designed loops are resampled.

fields.name: regions
fields.label: Regions to design
fields.help: One per line, as region:chain:start-end using 1-indexed positions within that chain, for example hcdr3:heavy:96-108. Designed in the order listed. IgDesign's own example configs are the reference for picking these ranges.

fields.name: pdb
fields.label: Protein PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A PROTEIN PDB HERE

fields.name: chain
fields.label: Chain
fields.help: The chain the mutations are scored in; the rest of the structure is context.

fields.name: mutations
fields.label: Mutations
fields.help: One per line, as wild-type residue, position, and mutant residue, for example T27A. Prefix with a chain and a colon to override the chain above.

fields.name: top_k
fields.label: Top mutations to highlight
fields.help: Return the K most stabilising substitutions alongside the full table. 0 returns the full table only.

fields.name: smiles
fields.label: Molecules as SMILES
fields.help: One SMILES string per line; 1 to 128 molecules.

fields.name: target_pdb
fields.label: Target PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A TARGET PDB HERE

fields.name: target_selection
fields.label: Target chain and residues
fields.help: Comma-separated PDB selections such as A1-40 or A2-158,B4-90.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Interface hotspots
fields.help: Comma-separated target chain/residue identifiers.

fields.name: heavy_sequence
fields.label: Heavy-chain variable domain
fields.help: Variable domain only. DeepSP was trained on Fv sequences.

fields.name: epitope
fields.label: Epitope
fields.help: A 9-mer or 10-mer peptide.

fields.name: pairs
fields.label: Epitope and allele pairs
fields.help: One pair per line, as epitope,allele.

fields.name: peptide
fields.label: Peptide
fields.help: 13 to 21 residues, the range the class II model was trained on.

fields.name: pairs
fields.label: Peptide and allele pairs
fields.help: One pair per line, as peptide,allele.

fields.name: fasta
fields.label: Sequences (FASTA)
fields.help: One or more records. Each is scored independently.

fields.name: fasta
fields.label: Sequences (FASTA)
fields.help: One or more records. Each is predicted independently.

fields.name: growth_temperature
fields.label: Growth temperature (C)
fields.help: The temperature the organism was cultured at, which the model conditions on.

fields.name: pdb
fields.label: Protein PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A PROTEIN PDB HERE

fields.name: chain
fields.label: Chain (optional)
fields.help: Restrict the analysis to one chain. Empty analyses the whole structure.

fields.name: distance
fields.label: Aggregation sphere radius (angstroms)
fields.help: Residues within this radius of each alpha carbon contribute to its score.

fields.name: dynamic
fields.label: Score over a CABS-flex ensemble
fields.help: Much slower, but accounts for flexibility instead of scoring one conformation.

fields.name: mutate
fields.label: Mutations to score (optional)
fields.help: One per line, as wild-type residue, mutant residue, position, and chain, for example MW1A. Needs FoldX.

fields.name: auto_mutation
fields.label: Solubility mutations to suggest
fields.help: Ask A3D to propose this many stability-aware solubility mutations. 0 skips the search. Needs FoldX.

fields.name: substrate_smiles
fields.label: Substrate SMILES
fields.help: The substrate as a SMILES string; DLKcat builds its molecular graph from this.

fields.name: substrate_name
fields.label: Substrate name
fields.help: Carried through to the output for readability; it does not affect the prediction.

fields.name: additional_entries
fields.label: Additional pairs (optional)
fields.help: More substrate/enzyme pairs to score in the same run, one per line, as name;SMILES;sequence.

fields.name: substrate_smiles
fields.label: Substrate SMILES
fields.help: For a Ki prediction this is the inhibitor rather than the substrate.

fields.name: ec_number
fields.label: EC number (optional)
fields.help: For example 2.7.1.1. Used as a feature where the model has one.

fields.name: organism
fields.label: Organism (optional)
fields.help: For example Escherichia coli.

fields.name: include_uncertainty
fields.label: Return the predicted uncertainty
fields.help: Lower predicted variance goes with higher accuracy, so this is worth keeping on.

fields.name: fasta
fields.label: Sequences (FASTA)
fields.help: One record per chain. Variable domains only; constant regions are not numbered.

fields.name: light_sequence
fields.label: Light-chain variable domain
fields.help: Leave the heavy chain alone and this empty is not supported: TAP profiles a paired Fv.

fields.name: cdr_definition
fields.label: CDR definition
fields.help: Which loop boundaries the CDR-length and patch metrics are measured over.

fields.name: return_model
fields.label: Return the structural model
fields.help: Include the homology model TAP built, as PDB text, alongside the metrics.

fields.name: structure_file
fields.label: Structure (PDB or mmCIF)
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A PROTEIN-LIGAND STRUCTURE HERE
fields.help: Only mmCIF files from RCSB are correctly parsed; PDB is the safer choice otherwise.

fields.name: num_samples
fields.label: Samples
fields.help: 50-100 is a good number for docking; fewer is fine for side-chain conformations alone.

fields.name: predict_ligand
fields.label: Ligands to predict (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated ligand IDs, as name3, name3-resno, or chain-name3-resno. Empty predicts every ligand present.

fields.name: fixed_ligand
fields.label: Ligands to hold fixed (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated ligand IDs kept at their input coordinates instead of being predicted.

fields.name: target_res
fields.label: Crop-center residue (optional)
fields.help: A protein residue, as chain-resno. Required when the input has no ligand at all.

fields.name: exclude_common_ligands
fields.label: Exclude common crystallography additives
fields.help: Drops solvents and crystallography additives (AlphaFold 3's exclusion list) before predicting.

fields.name: predict_multi
fields.label: Predict every allowed ligand
fields.help: Scores every eligible ligand rather than only the ones named in predict_ligand.

fields.name: use_small_molecule
fields.label: Include the small molecule
fields.help: Off predicts side chains only (apo), ignoring any ligand in the input.
